name: AI Venture Factory Opportunity Feed
purpose: Machine-readable discovery surface for zero-cash, repeatable or scalable opportunities that can create compounding assets or low-user-time economics.
accepted_patterns: recurring public-data normalization, comparison or monitoring
repetitive workflows packageable as tools, datasets, alerts or operating systems
buyer-supplier matching with transparent referral or brokerage economics
evaluation: Prefer the smallest reversible external test that can produce a real market response. Competition, uncertainty, manual friction, imperfect moat and low initial success probability are not automatic rejection reasons.
